stage.description: Dependency-tree cleanup target, e.g. current-scratch or abandoned-scratch

error.description: Filesystem error raised while deleting a Maven dependency-tree scratch file

executable.description: Executable URL from the process request, redacted to a safe path before persistence

exit_code.description: Exit status of the child process; absent when it could not start

outcome.description: Process completion category, e.g. exited, timed-out or cancelled
